name: Marker captions
description: A highlighter swipes under each word as it is said and stays lit, a little crooked like a real pen, so the line fills with the brand's colour as it is spoken (or an underline stroke). Give a transcript with --words; *starred* words take the second accent.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Every word you say gets *highlighted* as you say it.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

style.label: Marker
style.description: highlight: a block behind the word · underline: a thick stroke under it

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
